graph.title: Track Racer
notes: The pictures are small and ambiguous about exact stud positions, so stud/anti-stud indices are my best estimate. Piece-to-piece connectivity follows the steps.
Step 2: 2x6 plate is placed on the middle two rows of the 4x4 plate, overhanging the rear by two studs.
Step 3: the two wheel-holder plates attach to the underside (front one to the 4x4, rear one to the 2x6 overhang).
Front red 1x4 (b11, step 6) is attached at the front. Its exact mount is unclear; I joined it to the front wheel-holder plate.
The white 2x4 (b12) overlaps several studs. I joined it only to some studs of the 2x6 and to the rear trans-red plate (b7).
Step 8: two jumpers and two clip plates go on the white 2x4. Step 9: a third jumper bridges the two jumpers, and the red wheel arches sit on the side 1x4 plates.
Step 10: the third curved brick goes on the top jumper and the white 1x4 tile goes on the rear trans-red 1x2 plate (b13).
Step 11: the glow bars are clipped into the two clip plates.
Step 12: wheels sit on the holder plates' pins, with the wheel port named pin-hole.1 and no port named on the holder. Each tyre is on a wheel.
